component.name: Proton IP Scanner
component.summary: Find the devices on your network and check them for known vulnerabilities

description.p: Proton IP Scanner finds every device on your network — computers, phones, printers, TVs, smart plugs — and shows their IP address, MAC address, manufacturer, name and open ports. It can then check their services for known vulnerabilities and export a report.

ul.li: One-click scan of your own network, with the most common ports checked on every device
Device names from router DNS, NetBIOS, mDNS, LLMNR and UPnP; manufacturers from the IEEE registries
Ping test with live latency chart, packet loss, jitter and a plain-language verdict
Vulnerability assessment: service detection, known CVEs from NIST NVD ranked by CVSS v4, EPSS, CISA KEV and a priority rating
Offline CVE database for networks without internet
Excel and PDF reports, CSV and HTML device lists, light and dark theme
Optional Nmap engine (when installed) for operating systems, service versions and safe scripts
Never needs root or administrator rights

description.p: Only scan networks you own or have permission to scan.

screenshot.caption: Devices on the network with their details
Vulnerability assessment with the Top 10 by priority

description.p: Optional Nmap engine: identify operating systems and exact service versions, and use Nmap's safe scripts in vulnerability assessments. A deep scan asks for administrator rights for that one scan only. Five new configuration checks.
Available as a Flatpak, and listed in KDE Discover and other app stores.
Windows installer, an Update CVE database button and automatic CVE database updates when the app opens. The Linux package now installs on Debian 11+ and Ubuntu 20.04+.
Offline vulnerability database for networks without internet, Comprehensive and Full port lists, and more device names from router DNS and UPnP.
New Vulnerability Scanner tab with CVE lookups, Excel and PDF reports, a ping test and mDNS/LLMNR names.
